```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to protecting and advancing reproductive health, rights, and justice.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe every woman should have access to quality reproductive health care services, including safe and legal abortion, regardless of where she lives, how much money she makes, or how she is insured.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe reproductive health is core to women's, men's, and young people's health and wellbeing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to stand up to Republican efforts to defund Planned Parenthood health centers, which provide critical health services to millions of people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to oppose—and seek to overturn—federal and state laws and policies that impede a woman's access to abortion, including by repealing the Hyde Amendment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats condemn and will combat any acts of violence, harassment, and intimidation of reproductive health providers, patients, and staff.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will defend the ACA, which extends affordable preventive health care to women, including no-cost contraception, and prohibits discrimination in health care based on gender.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will address the discrimination and barriers that inhibit meaningful access to reproductive health care services, including those based on gender, sexuality, race, income, disability, and other factors.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Quality, affordable comprehensive health care, evidence-based sex education and a full range of family planning services help reduce the number of unintended pregnancies and thereby also reduce the need for abortions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
